full_judgment: 2. The 1st party filed an application before S.D.O.(s), Dinajpur, on 4-11-72 under section 144 Cr.P.C. in respect of the disputed land praying for drawing up proceedings against the 2nd party as there was apprehension for breach of the peace. The learned S.D.O. drew up proceedings and restrained the members of the 2nd party from entering into the disputed land and asked them to show cause by 20-11-72. Thereafter, both the parties filed statements and the learned Magistrate on 30-12-72 converter the proceedings into one under section 145 Cr.P.C and asked both the parties to file written statements. Accordingly both the parties filed written statements and the case was fixed on 3-4-73 for evidence. On that date 1st party was absent by a petition and so the case was adjourned to 5-5-73 for evidence of the 1st party. On 5-5-73 the learned Magistrate after perusing a judgment of this court in S.A. No. 204 without taking any further evidence of the 1st party and without giving the 2nd party any opportunity to adduce evidence in support of their case passed the impugned order declaring possession of the disputed land in favour of the 1st party and withdrawing the order of attachment asking the receiver to deliver possession of the disputed land to the 1st party.
